pins.tips: Ideal staging base for the nearby Ambrosia State Gold Reserve heist.
pins.exfil: Gravel orchard tracks connecting to Interstate.

pins.title: Ambrosia Highway Pay 'N' Spray
pins.payout: Fast Respray + Heavy Vehicle Engine Tune
pins.description: Highway truck stop respray shop servicing agricultural tankers and getaway sedans fleeing northern Leonida heists.
pins.tips: Drive in right as police cruisers lose line of sight around the citrus factory corner.
pins.exfil: Interstate 95 on-ramp within 100 meters.

pins.title: Mount Kalaga Cold War Emergency Bunker
pins.description: Decommissioned military civil defense bunker tunneled directly into Kalaga bedrock. Zero radio signature, reinforced blast doors, and mountain helipad.
pins.tips: Absolute safety; police will completely abandon pursuit once blast doors are sealed.
pins.exfil: Mountain dirt road or helicopter climb.

pins.title: Lake Leonida Hidden Boathouse & Slip
pins.description: Covered wooden boathouse tucked inside an overgrown lagoon off Lake Leonida. Overhead cypress canopy shields boats from police chopper thermal cameras.
pins.tips: Perfect transfer station when escaping from central Leonida bank heists.
pins.exfil: Speedboat into deep lake waterways.
